source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Tune Up, p.6-1

procedures.title: Engine tune up: general approach
steps: Do a complete tune up rather than fixing just one or two items.
Part one: do the visual and mechanical checks and adjustments.
Part two: do the instrument checkout with the available test equipment, following that equipment maker's instructions.
If a condition needing major repair turns up, go to the relevant section of this manual or the Passenger Chassis Overhaul Manual.
notes: Higher compression, better electrical systems and other design changes make these engines more sensitive to tune; tune affects power, performance and fuel use.

procedures.title: Spark plugs: remove
steps: Blow dirt away from around the plugs with compressed air.
Disconnect the plug wires and take out the plugs.

procedures.title: Compression test
steps: Take off the air cleaner and block the throttle and choke wide open.
Connect the remote starter cable and press the compression gauge firmly into a spark plug hole (see figure 1 in the manual).
notes: Low or uneven compression must be corrected before the tune up can succeed.
